en: Ali! Welcome to Calgary, brother! I'm stuck at work, so take the Airport Express bus downtown and I'll meet you there.
There you are! This is downtown. Tomorrow we start your to-do list: newcomer centre, driver's licence, car and insurance. Calgary is going to be good to you.
First stop: the Centre for Newcomers on 36 Street NE. They helped me with everything when I arrived. Take the CTrain to Rundle, drive, or walk!
In Alberta, driver's licences are done at a registry agent. McKnight Registry is on Aviation Road NE. Let's go!
You passed the knowledge test! Your road test is booked: it starts right here. The examiner will ride with you. Obey the speed limits and drive carefully!
Good morning. Get in the car when you're ready (press F or 🚗). Drive through each checkpoint, keep to the speed limit and don't hit anything. Three mistakes and the test is over.
Licence done! Before you drive your own car you need insurance. Let's get quotes at TD Auto Insurance Centre on 1 Street SE.
Your new place is in Martindale. The Genesis Centre in Saddletowne has a gym, a library, a YMCA and community programs. Let's check it out.
See? You're not alone here. Now let's ride the CTrain so you know how to get downtown.
Natalia! New semester at Nelson Mandela High! Walk with me, it's just south of the station.
Natalia, look over there! Those older kids are pushing a Grade 7 kid around and taking his stuff.
Wait, Natalia! Fighting back or insulting them makes it worse. Watch: stay calm, stand next to him and speak up.
Hey. Stop. This isn't funny, and you know it.
A joke is when everyone is laughing. He isn't laughing.
Pushing someone and taking his stuff is bullying. And everyone watching knows it.
So what are you going to do about it?
I'm walking him to the office, and we're telling a teacher. You can come and explain, or you can leave him alone. Your choice.
You okay? You didn't do anything wrong. Come on, let's go together.
Th-thanks. They do this every day. I didn't know what to do.
See the new girl by herself? That's Amira. She eats lunch alone every day, and that group keeps whispering about her.
Hi! I'm Natalia, and this is Maya. Do you want to eat lunch with us?
Really? I just moved here from Syria. My English isn't very good yet.
Your English is great. And you speak two languages. That's one more than me!
I heard what you were saying about her clothes.
Leaving someone out on purpose, or making fun of where they're from or what they wear, is bullying too.
We didn't mean anything by it.
Everyone here was new once. Let's make her first week a good one. Come and sit with us.
Hi Amira. Want to sit with us?
Thank you. This is the best day since I came to Calgary.
Natalia, did you see the class group chat? Someone posted an edited photo of Jordan, and everyone's laughing at it.
Hey. About that photo of Jordan in the group chat.
It was just a joke. Everyone was posting.
Everyone posting is exactly why it hurts. One click, and the whole school saw it.
Online bullying is still bullying. In Alberta, students have to report bullying, even when it happens online.
I told our teacher, and the post is being taken down. Can you delete what you shared?
Yeah... you're right. I'm deleting it now.
Jordan, I'm sorry that happened. You didn't deserve it. We've got your back.
Thanks, Natalia. I thought nobody cared.
The principal wants us to visit the younger kids around the school and share what we know about bullying. Three groups are waiting!
Natalia! The principal asked you to speak at the anti-bullying assembly. Everyone is outside waiting for you!
Students, please welcome Natalia from Grade 10.
Hi everyone. This term I saw a Grade 7 kid pushed around, a new student eating lunch alone, and a photo that went around our group chat.
Every time, lots of people saw it. And most of us did nothing. I used to be one of them.
Here's what I learned. Bullies need an audience. When we stop laughing and stand next to the person instead, it usually stops.
You don't have to fight. Stay calm, say "Stop," get the person to safety, and tell an adult.
If it happens online: don't reply, save the proof, block, report, and tell someone.
And if you're the one being bullied: it's not your fault. You can call Kids Help Phone any time, day or night.
Let's make this a school where nobody walks alone. Who's with me?
Thank you, Natalia. That took real courage.
Dad, you've been home alone too much since you retired. The Kerby Centre is right on 7 Avenue. Will you go and see what they offer? For me?
Tai chi on Tuesdays? I'm signing you up!
You don't need to drive downtown anymore. Seniors can get a yearly transit pass. Let's walk to the 7 Avenue CTrain platform and ride to City Hall.
Your doctor said walk every day. Prince's Island Park is flat and beautiful. Let's go!
"Hello grandpa, it's me! I'm in jail and I need $2,000 in gift cards right now. Don't tell mom!"
New order! Pick up from a local restaurant near you and drive it to the customer. Grab the family car outside or go on foot!
Jean! Collection day tomorrow. Can you help me sort my stuff? My son put everything in the wrong cart again.
It snowed last night! Mrs. Kaur next door is 80 and can't shovel. Can you clear her walk and yours?
Tonight there's a concert at the Saddledome! Park downtown or take the CTrain to Victoria Park / Stampede Station.
Welcome to Calgary, Leo! I'm Sofia, your guide for the next few days. Let's start with the best view in town: the Calgary Tower, just down 9 Avenue.
Tip: come back at sunset. You get the city lights and the mountains at the same time.
Now let's walk Stephen Avenue, one block north. It's a pedestrian street full of restaurants, shops and old sandstone buildings.
Next, let's catch the CTrain on 7 Avenue. Meet me at City Hall station.
Calgary is a city of rivers and pathways. Walk west along the Bow River to the Peace Bridge, the red bridge you can see from here.
East Village is just past City Hall. First stop: the Central Library. Even if you're only visiting, it's worth seeing.
Now east to where Calgary began: Fort Calgary, where the Bow and Elbow rivers meet.
Last stop today: Stampede Park, home of the Calgary Stampede.
You've seen downtown. Before you go further, let's make sure you can explore safely on your own.
That's my tour, Leo. The rest of the city is yours. Enjoy Calgary!
fr: Ali ! Bienvenue à Calgary, mon frère ! Je suis coincé au travail, alors prends le bus Airport Express jusqu'au centre-ville et je te retrouve là-bas.
Te voilà ! C'est le centre-ville. Demain, on commence ta liste : centre pour nouveaux arrivants, permis de conduire, voiture et assurance. Calgary va bien te traiter.
Premier arrêt : le Centre for Newcomers sur la 36e Rue NE. Ils m'ont aidé pour tout à mon arrivée. Prends le CTrain jusqu'à Rundle, conduis ou marche !
En Alberta, les permis de conduire se font chez un agent d'immatriculation (registry). McKnight Registry est sur Aviation Road NE. Allons-y !
Vous avez réussi l'examen théorique ! Votre examen de conduite est réservé : il commence ici même. L'examinateur sera avec vous. Respectez les limites de vitesse et conduisez prudemment !
Bonjour. Montez dans la voiture quand vous êtes prêt (touche F ou 🚗). Passez par chaque point de contrôle, respectez la limite de vitesse et ne heurtez rien. Trois erreurs et l'examen est terminé.
Permis en poche ! Avant de conduire ta propre voiture, il te faut une assurance. Allons chercher des soumissions chez TD Auto Insurance Centre sur la 1re Rue SE.
Ton nouveau chez-toi est à Martindale. Le Genesis Centre à Saddletowne a un gym, une bibliothèque, un YMCA et des programmes communautaires. Allons voir.
Tu vois ? Tu n'es pas seul ici. Maintenant, prenons le CTrain pour que tu saches aller au centre-ville.
Natalia ! Nouveau semestre à Nelson Mandela High ! Viens avec moi, c'est juste au sud de la station.
Natalia, regarde là-bas ! Ces grands bousculent un élève de 7e année et lui prennent ses affaires.
Attends, Natalia! Riposter ou les insulter empire les choses. Regarde : reste calme, mets-toi à côté de lui et parle.
Hé. Arrêtez. Ce n'est pas drôle, et vous le savez.
Relaxe. On fait juste des blagues.
Une blague, c'est quand tout le monde rit. Lui, il ne rit pas.
Bousculer quelqu'un et lui prendre ses affaires, c'est de l'intimidation. Et tous ceux qui regardent le savent.
Je l'accompagne au bureau, et on va le dire à un enseignant. Vous pouvez venir vous expliquer, ou le laisser tranquille. À vous de choisir.
Ça va? Tu n'as rien fait de mal. Viens, on y va ensemble.
M-merci. Ils font ça tous les jours. Je ne savais pas quoi faire.
Tu vois la nouvelle, toute seule? C'est Amira. Elle mange seule tous les midis, et ce groupe chuchote sur elle.
Salut! Je suis Natalia, et voici Maya. Tu veux manger avec nous?
C'est vrai? Je viens d'arriver de Syrie. Mon anglais n'est pas encore très bon.
Ton anglais est super. Et tu parles deux langues. C'est une de plus que moi!
J'ai entendu ce que vous disiez sur ses vêtements.
Exclure quelqu'un exprès, ou se moquer de son pays ou de ce qu'elle porte, c'est aussi de l'intimidation.
On ne voulait pas être méchants.
Tout le monde ici a été nouveau un jour. Faisons de sa première semaine une bonne semaine. Venez vous asseoir avec nous.
Salut Amira. Tu veux t'asseoir avec nous?
Merci. C'est la plus belle journée depuis que je suis arrivée à Calgary.
Natalia, tu as vu le clavardage de la classe? Quelqu'un a publié une photo truquée de Jordan, et tout le monde s'en moque.
Hé. À propos de la photo de Jordan dans le clavardage.
C'était juste une blague. Tout le monde en publiait.
C'est justement parce que tout le monde en publiait que ça fait mal. Un clic, et toute l'école l'a vue.
L'intimidation en ligne, c'est de l'intimidation. En Alberta, les élèves doivent signaler l'intimidation, même quand elle se passe en ligne.
J'en ai parlé à notre enseignant, et la publication va être retirée. Tu peux supprimer ce que tu as partagé?
Oui... tu as raison. Je la supprime maintenant.
Jordan, je suis désolée pour ce qui s'est passé. Tu ne méritais pas ça. On est là pour toi.
Merci, Natalia. Je pensais que personne ne s'en souciait.
La directrice veut qu'on rende visite aux plus jeunes autour de l'école pour parler de l'intimidation. Trois groupes nous attendent !
Natalia! La directrice t'a demandé de prendre la parole à l'assemblée contre l'intimidation. Tout le monde t'attend dehors!
Chers élèves, accueillez Natalia, de 10e année.
Bonjour à tous. Ce semestre, j'ai vu un élève de 7e année se faire bousculer, une nouvelle élève manger seule, et une photo circuler dans notre clavardage de groupe.
Chaque fois, beaucoup de gens ont vu. Et la plupart d'entre nous n'ont rien fait. Avant, j'étais comme eux.
Voici ce que j'ai appris. Les intimidateurs ont besoin d'un public. Quand on arrête de rire et qu'on se place à côté de la personne, ça s'arrête souvent.
Pas besoin de se battre. Restez calmes, dites « Arrête », mettez la personne en sécurité et prévenez un adulte.
Si ça se passe en ligne : ne répondez pas, gardez les preuves, bloquez, signalez et parlez-en à quelqu'un.
Et si c'est vous qu'on intimide : ce n'est pas votre faute. Vous pouvez appeler Jeunesse, J'écoute à toute heure, de jour comme de nuit.
Faisons de cette école un endroit où personne n'est seul. Qui est avec moi?
Merci, Natalia. Il fallait beaucoup de courage.
Papa, tu es trop souvent seul à la maison depuis ta retraite. Le Kerby Centre est juste sur la 7e Avenue. Tu veux bien aller voir ce qu'ils offrent ? Pour moi ?
Du tai-chi le mardi ? Je t'inscris !
Tu n'as plus besoin de conduire au centre-ville. Les aînés peuvent avoir un laissez-passer annuel. Marchons jusqu'au quai du CTrain de la 7e Avenue et allons à City Hall.
Ton médecin a dit de marcher tous les jours. Le parc Prince's Island est plat et magnifique. Allons-y !
« Allô grand-papa, c'est moi ! Je suis en prison et j'ai besoin de 2 000 $ en cartes-cadeaux tout de suite. Ne le dis pas à maman ! »
Nouvelle commande ! Récupérez-la dans un restaurant du quartier et livrez-la au client. Prenez la voiture familiale dehors ou allez-y à pied !
Jean ! C'est la collecte demain. Tu peux m'aider à trier mes affaires ? Mon fils a encore tout mis dans le mauvais bac.
Il a neigé cette nuit ! Mme Kaur, la voisine, a 80 ans et ne peut pas pelleter. Tu peux déneiger son trottoir et le tien ?
Ce soir, il y a un concert au Saddledome ! Stationne au centre-ville ou prends le CTrain jusqu'à la station Victoria Park / Stampede.
Bienvenue à Calgary, Leo! Je suis Sofia, ta guide pour les prochains jours. Commençons par la plus belle vue de la ville : la tour de Calgary, au bout de la 9e Avenue.
Conseil : reviens au coucher du soleil. Tu verras les lumières de la ville et les montagnes en même temps.
Maintenant, marchons sur Stephen Avenue, une rue plus au nord. C'est une rue piétonne pleine de restaurants, de boutiques et de vieux édifices en grès.
Ensuite, prenons le CTrain sur la 7e Avenue. Rejoins-moi à la station City Hall.
Calgary est une ville de rivières et de sentiers. Marche vers l'ouest le long de la rivière Bow jusqu'au pont de la Paix, le pont rouge que tu vois d'ici.
East Village est juste après l'hôtel de ville. Premier arrêt : la Bibliothèque centrale. Même si tu es seulement de passage, ça vaut le détour.
Maintenant, vers l'est, là où Calgary est née : Fort Calgary, où se rejoignent les rivières Bow et Elbow.
Dernier arrêt aujourd'hui : le parc du Stampede, où a lieu le Stampede de Calgary.
Tu as vu le centre-ville. Avant d'aller plus loin, assurons-nous que tu peux explorer seul en sécurité.
Voilà ma visite, Leo. Le reste de la ville est à toi. Profite de Calgary!
pa: ਅਲੀ! ਕੈਲਗਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਜੀ ਆਇਆਂ ਨੂੰ, ਭਰਾ! ਮੈਂ ਕੰਮ ਤੇ ਫਸਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹਾਂ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਏਅਰਪੋਰਟ ਐਕਸਪ੍ਰੈਸ ਬੱਸ ਫੜ ਕੇ ਡਾਊਨਟਾਊਨ ਆ ਜਾ, ਮੈਂ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਉੱਥੇ ਮਿਲਾਂਗਾ।
ਆ ਗਿਆ ਤੂੰ! ਇਹ ਡਾਊਨਟਾਊਨ ਹੈ। ਕੱਲ੍ਹ ਤੋਂ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੰਮਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ: ਨਿਊਕਮਰ ਸੈਂਟਰ, ਡਰਾਈਵਿੰਗ ਲਾਇਸੈਂਸ, ਕਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਬੀਮਾ। ਕੈਲਗਰੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਲਈ ਚੰਗਾ ਰਹੇਗਾ।
ਪਹਿਲਾ ਸਟਾਪ: 36 ਸਟ੍ਰੀਟ NE ਤੇ Centre for Newcomers। ਜਦੋਂ ਮੈਂ ਆਇਆ ਸੀ ਤਾਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਹਰ ਚੀਜ਼ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਦਦ ਕੀਤੀ। ਰੰਡਲ ਤੱਕ ਸੀ-ਟ੍ਰੇਨ ਲੈ, ਗੱਡੀ ਚਲਾ, ਜਾਂ ਤੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਾ!
ਅਲਬਰਟਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਡਰਾਈਵਿੰਗ ਲਾਇਸੈਂਸ ਰਜਿਸਟਰੀ ਏਜੰਟ ਕੋਲ ਬਣਦੇ ਹਨ। McKnight Registry ਏਵੀਏਸ਼ਨ ਰੋਡ NE ਤੇ ਹੈ। ਚੱਲੀਏ!
ਤੁਸੀਂ ਲਿਖਤੀ ਟੈਸਟ ਪਾਸ ਕਰ ਲਿਆ! ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਰੋਡ ਟੈਸਟ ਬੁੱਕ ਹੈ: ਇਹ ਇੱਥੋਂ ਹੀ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਐਗਜ਼ਾਮੀਨਰ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਨਾਲ ਬੈਠੇਗਾ। ਸਪੀਡ ਲਿਮਿਟ ਮੰਨੋ ਅਤੇ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਲ ਚਲਾਓ!
ਸਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ। ਜਦੋਂ ਤਿਆਰ ਹੋਵੋ ਤਾਂ ਕਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੈਠੋ (F ਜਾਂ 🚗 ਦਬਾਓ)। ਹਰ ਚੈਕਪੁਆਇੰਟ ਤੋਂ ਲੰਘੋ, ਸਪੀਡ ਲਿਮਿਟ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹੋ ਅਤੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਚੀਜ਼ ਨਾਲ ਨਾ ਟਕਰਾਓ। ਤਿੰਨ ਗਲਤੀਆਂ ਤੇ ਟੈਸਟ ਖ਼ਤਮ।
ਲਾਇਸੈਂਸ ਬਣ ਗਿਆ! ਆਪਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਚਲਾਉਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਬੀਮਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ। 1 ਸਟ੍ਰੀਟ SE ਤੇ TD Auto Insurance Centre ਤੋਂ ਰੇਟ ਪੁੱਛੀਏ।
ਤੇਰਾ ਨਵਾਂ ਘਰ ਮਾਰਟਿੰਡੇਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੈ। ਸੈਡਲਟਾਊਨ ਦੇ Genesis Centre ਵਿੱਚ ਜਿਮ, ਲਾਇਬ੍ਰੇਰੀ, YMCA ਅਤੇ ਕਮਿਊਨਿਟੀ ਪ੍ਰੋਗਰਾਮ ਹਨ। ਚੱਲ ਦੇਖੀਏ।
ਦੇਖਿਆ? ਤੂੰ ਇੱਥੇ ਇਕੱਲਾ ਨਹੀਂ। ਹੁਣ ਸੀ-ਟ੍ਰੇਨ ਲਈਏ ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਡਾਊਨਟਾਊਨ ਜਾਣ ਦਾ ਪਤਾ ਲੱਗੇ।
ਨਤਾਲੀਆ! ਨੈਲਸਨ ਮੰਡੇਲਾ ਹਾਈ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਵਾਂ ਸਮੈਸਟਰ! ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਲ ਤੁਰ, ਸਕੂਲ ਸਟੇਸ਼ਨ ਦੇ ਬਿਲਕੁਲ ਦੱਖਣ ਵੱਲ ਹੈ।
ਨਤਾਲੀਆ, ਉੱਧਰ ਦੇਖ! ਉਹ ਵੱਡੇ ਮੁੰਡੇ ਗ੍ਰੇਡ 7 ਦੇ ਇੱਕ ਬੱਚੇ ਨੂੰ ਧੱਕੇ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਨ ਖੋਹ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ।
ਰੁਕ, ਨਤਾਲੀਆ! ਮੋੜਵਾਂ ਵਾਰ ਜਾਂ ਗਾਲ੍ਹਾਂ ਗੱਲ ਵਿਗਾੜ ਦਿੰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਦੇਖ: ਸ਼ਾਂਤ ਰਹਿ, ਉਸ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਖੜ੍ਹ ਅਤੇ ਬੋਲ।
ਓਏ। ਬੱਸ ਕਰੋ। ਇਹ ਮਜ਼ਾਕ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਪਤਾ ਹੈ।
ਆਰਾਮ ਨਾਲ। ਅਸੀਂ ਤਾਂ ਬੱਸ ਮਜ਼ਾਕ ਕਰ ਰਹੇ ਹਾਂ।
ਮਜ਼ਾਕ ਉਹ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਹੱਸਣ। ਉਹ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੱਸ ਰਿਹਾ।
ਕਿਸੇ ਨੂੰ ਧੱਕੇ ਦੇਣਾ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਨ ਖੋਹਣਾ ਧੱਕੇਸ਼ਾਹੀ ਹੈ। ਅਤੇ ਦੇਖਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਇਹ ਜਾਣਦੇ ਹਨ।
ਮੈਂ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਦਫ਼ਤਰ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਜਾ ਰਹੀ ਹਾਂ, ਅਤੇ ਅਸੀਂ ਅਧਿਆਪਕ ਨੂੰ ਦੱਸਾਂਗੇ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆ ਕੇ ਸਫ਼ਾਈ ਦੇ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ, ਜਾਂ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਛੱਡ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ। ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਮਰਜ਼ੀ।
ਤੂੰ ਠੀਕ ਹੈਂ? ਤੇਰੀ ਕੋਈ ਗਲਤੀ ਨਹੀਂ। ਆ, ਇਕੱਠੇ ਚੱਲੀਏ।
ਸ਼-ਸ਼ੁਕਰੀਆ। ਉਹ ਹਰ ਰੋਜ਼ ਇਹੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਮੈਨੂੰ ਸਮਝ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਸੀ ਕੀ ਕਰਾਂ।
ਉਸ ਨਵੀਂ ਕੁੜੀ ਨੂੰ ਇਕੱਲਿਆਂ ਦੇਖ ਰਹੀ ਹੈਂ? ਉਹ ਅਮੀਰਾ ਹੈ। ਉਹ ਰੋਜ਼ ਇਕੱਲੀ ਖਾਣਾ ਖਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਗਰੁੱਪ ਉਸ ਬਾਰੇ ਘੁਸਰ-ਮੁਸਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
ਹਾਏ! ਮੈਂ ਨਤਾਲੀਆ ਹਾਂ, ਅਤੇ ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਹੈ। ਕੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਡੇ ਨਾਲ ਲੰਚ ਕਰੇਂਗੀ?
ਸੱਚੀਂ? ਮੈਂ ਹੁਣੇ ਸੀਰੀਆ ਤੋਂ ਆਈ ਹਾਂ। ਮੇਰੀ ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਅਜੇ ਬਹੁਤ ਚੰਗੀ ਨਹੀਂ।

tl: Ali! Maligayang pagdating sa Calgary, pare! Naiipit ako sa trabaho, kaya sumakay ka ng Airport Express bus papuntang downtown at doon na tayo magkita.
Nandiyan ka na! Ito ang downtown. Bukas sisimulan natin ang listahan mo: newcomer centre, lisensya sa pagmamaneho, kotse at insurance. Magiging mabuti sa iyo ang Calgary.
Unang hinto: ang Centre for Newcomers sa 36 Street NE. Tinulungan nila ako sa lahat nang dumating ako. Sumakay ng CTrain papuntang Rundle, magmaneho, o maglakad!
Sa Alberta, ang lisensya sa pagmamaneho ay kinukuha sa registry agent. Nasa Aviation Road NE ang McKnight Registry. Tara!
Pumasa ka sa knowledge test! Naka-book na ang road test mo: dito mismo magsisimula. Sasama sa iyo ang examiner. Sundin ang speed limit at magmaneho nang maingat!
Magandang umaga. Sumakay sa kotse kapag handa ka na (pindutin ang F o 🚗). Dumaan sa bawat checkpoint, sumunod sa speed limit at huwag bumangga. Tatlong mali at tapos ang test.
Tapos na ang lisensya! Bago mo imaneho ang sarili mong kotse, kailangan mo ng insurance. Kumuha tayo ng quote sa TD Auto Insurance Centre sa 1 Street SE.
Nasa Martindale ang bago mong tirahan. Ang Genesis Centre sa Saddletowne ay may gym, library, YMCA at mga programa sa komunidad. Tingnan natin.
Kita mo? Hindi ka nag-iisa rito. Ngayon sumakay tayo ng CTrain para alam mo kung paano pumunta sa downtown.
Natalia! Bagong semestre sa Nelson Mandela High! Sabay tayong maglakad, nasa timog lang ito ng istasyon.
Natalia, tingnan mo doon! Tinutulak ng mga mas matatandang estudyante ang isang Grade 7 at kinukuha ang mga gamit niya.
Teka, Natalia! Lalala kung lalaban ka o iinsultuhin mo sila. Tingnan mo: manatiling kalmado, tumayo sa tabi niya at magsalita.
Hoy. Tama na. Hindi ito nakakatawa, at alam n'yo 'yan.
Biro 'yan kapag lahat ay tumatawa. Hindi siya tumatawa.
Ang pagtulak sa isang tao at pagkuha ng gamit niya ay bullying. At alam ito ng lahat ng nanonood.
Dadalhin ko siya sa opisina, at magsasabi kami sa guro. Puwede kayong sumama at magpaliwanag, o hayaan n'yo na lang siya. Kayo ang bahala.
Okay ka lang? Wala kang ginawang mali. Halika, sabay tayong pumunta.
S-salamat. Ginagawa nila ito araw-araw. Hindi ko alam ang gagawin.
Nakikita mo ba ang bagong estudyanteng mag-isa? Si Amira 'yan. Mag-isa siyang kumakain araw-araw, at panay ang bulungan ng grupong 'yon tungkol sa kanya.
Hi! Ako si Natalia, at ito si Maya. Gusto mo bang kumain ng lunch kasama namin?
Talaga? Kalilipat ko lang mula sa Syria. Hindi pa masyadong maganda ang English ko.
Ang galing ng English mo. At dalawang wika ang alam mo. Isa pa 'yan kaysa sa akin!
Narinig ko ang sinasabi n'yo tungkol sa damit niya.
Bullying din ang sadyang pag-iiwan sa isang tao, o ang pagtawanan kung saan siya galing o ang suot niya.
Wala naman kaming masamang ibig sabihin.
Lahat tayo dito ay naging bago minsan. Gawin nating maganda ang una niyang linggo. Halika, umupo kayo sa amin.
Hi Amira. Gusto mo bang umupo sa amin?
Salamat. Ito ang pinakamagandang araw ko mula nang dumating ako sa Calgary.
Natalia, nakita mo ba ang group chat ng klase? May nag-post ng in-edit na litrato ni Jordan, at pinagtatawanan ito ng lahat.
Hoy. Tungkol sa litrato ni Jordan sa group chat.
Biro lang 'yon. Nagpo-post naman ang lahat.
Kaya nga masakit, dahil lahat ay nagpo-post. Isang click lang, at nakita na ng buong paaralan.
Bullying pa rin ang online bullying. Sa Alberta, dapat i-report ng mga estudyante ang bullying, kahit online ito nangyari.
Sinabihan ko na ang guro natin, at tinatanggal na ang post. Puwede mo bang burahin ang na-share mo?
Oo... tama ka. Binubura ko na ngayon.
Jordan, ikinalulungkot ko ang nangyari. Hindi mo 'yon deserve. Nandito kami para sa'yo.
Salamat, Natalia. Akala ko walang may pakialam.
Gusto ng principal na bisitahin natin ang mga mas batang estudyante sa paligid ng paaralan at ibahagi ang alam natin tungkol sa bullying. Tatlong grupo ang naghihintay!
Natalia! Gusto ng principal na magsalita ka sa anti-bullying assembly. Naghihintay na sa'yo ang lahat sa labas!
Mga estudyante, salubungin natin si Natalia mula sa Grade 10.
Hi sa inyong lahat. Ngayong semestre, nakita ko ang isang Grade 7 na tinutulak-tulak, isang bagong estudyanteng mag-isang kumakain, at isang litratong kumalat sa group chat natin.
Sa bawat pagkakataon, maraming nakakita. At karamihan sa atin ay walang ginawa. Dati, isa ako sa kanila.
Ito ang natutunan ko. Kailangan ng bully ng audience. Kapag tumigil tayo sa pagtawa at tumayo sa tabi ng tao, kadalasan ay tumitigil ito.
Hindi mo kailangang makipag-away. Manatiling kalmado, sabihing "Tama na," dalhin ang tao sa ligtas na lugar, at magsabi sa isang adult.
Kung online ito nangyari: huwag sumagot, itago ang patunay, i-block, i-report, at magsabi sa isang tao.
At kung ikaw ang binu-bully: hindi mo ito kasalanan. Puwede kang tumawag sa Kids Help Phone anumang oras, araw man o gabi.
Gawin natin ang paaralang ito na lugar kung saan walang naglalakad nang mag-isa. Sino ang kasama ko?
Salamat, Natalia. Totoong tapang ang kailangan doon.
Tay, masyado ka nang mag-isa sa bahay mula nang magretiro ka. Nasa 7 Avenue lang ang Kerby Centre. Puwede mo bang tingnan kung ano ang inaalok nila? Para sa akin?

Umulan ng niyebe kagabi! Si Mrs. Kaur sa tabi ay 80 na at hindi makapag-shovel. Puwede mo bang linisin ang daanan niya at ang sa iyo?
May konsiyerto mamayang gabi sa Saddledome! Mag-park sa downtown o sumakay ng CTrain papunta sa Victoria Park / Stampede Station.
Maligayang pagdating sa Calgary, Leo! Ako si Sofia, ang gabay mo sa mga susunod na araw. Simulan natin sa pinakamagandang tanawin sa lungsod: ang Calgary Tower, diretso lang sa 9 Avenue.
Tip: bumalik ka sa paglubog ng araw. Makikita mo ang mga ilaw ng lungsod at ang mga bundok nang sabay.
